interval.description: How frequently funds will be paid out. One of `manual` (payouts only created via API call), `daily`, `weekly`, or `monthly`.

monthly_payout_days.description: The day of the month funds will be paid out. Only shown if `interval` is monthly. Payouts scheduled between the 29th and 31st of the month are sent on the last day of shorter months.

weekly_payout_days.description: The days of the week when available funds are paid out, specified as an array, for example, [`monday`, `tuesday`]. Only shown if `interval` is weekly.
